county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was not a record of monthly fire drills conducted for licensing to review.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §744.801(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Playground checklists had not been completed for January 2025.

top_violation_types.title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection, there were 11 infants in care and the total capacity for infants in the permit is 10.

top_violation_types.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation no longer has  a fenced outdoor area.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four diaper changing areas still did not have sinks.

top_violation_types.title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children are left in buggies longer than fiftteen minutes which is the maximum time frame a child may be in a restrictive device.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.
